title: ～を通じて／～を通して — through ～ / throughout ～
summary: Has two uses. It means “through, by means of” a person, medium or experience, and “throughout” a period of time or a range. It follows a noun. 通じて and 通して are almost interchangeable in meaning.

patterns.form: 名詞（人・媒体）＋を通じて／を通して
patterns.gloss: through a person or medium (友だちを通して)

patterns.form: 名詞（期間・範囲）＋を通じて／を通して
patterns.gloss: throughout a period (一年を通じて)

body.p: As in 彼を通じて社長と知り合った or 友だちを通して仕事を紹介してもらった, a person or thing stands in between and you do or get something that way. The key point is that it is not direct; someone or something is in between. It also works with newspapers, the internet and experience.

As in 一年を通じて暖かい, a state continues over the whole of a period (a year, the four seasons, a lifetime). The second half is a continuing state or habit, not a one-off event. Both 通じて and 通して are fine, though 通じて is more common for periods.

examples.ja: 彼（かれ）を通（つう）じて、社長（しゃちょう）と知（し）り合（あ）った。
examples.romaji: Kare o tsūjite, shachō to shiriatta.
examples.tr: I got to know the president through him.

examples.ja: 一年（いちねん）を通（つう）じて、この島（しま）は暖（あたた）かい。
examples.romaji: Ichinen o tsūjite, kono shima wa atatakai.
examples.tr: This island is warm throughout the year.

examples.ja: 友（とも）だちを通（とお）して、その仕事（しごと）を紹介（しょうかい）してもらった。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi o tōshite, sono shigoto o shōkai shite moratta.
examples.tr: I got that job introduced to me through a friend.
examples.note: 通して has the same meaning as 通じて here.

pitfalls: The means use implies someone or something in between. Do not use it for direct contact.
In the period use, do not follow it with a one-off event: × 一年を通じて、旅行した.
